title: Spanish Tapas for Two Board
seo_title: Spanish Tapas Board for Two: Manchego, Jamón & Shopping List
description: A Spanish tapas board for two: aged Manchego, Mahón or Idiazabal, jamón serrano, chorizo, membrillo, Marcona almonds, piquillo peppers and pan con tomate.
hook: Small bites, late night, big flavor: a tapas spread for two with pan con tomate made at the table.
why: Manchego with membrillo (quince paste) is the most famous Spanish pairing: the sweet, firm paste against the nutty, salty sheep's milk cheese. A second cheese, buttery Mahón or smoky Idiazabal, gives you a contrast.

Jamón serrano and dry chorizo cover the meat, and Marcona almonds, olives and piquillo peppers fill out the tapas. Rubbing a ripe tomato and garlic on toasted bread makes pan con tomate. Fino sherry or a Rioja Crianza to drink.

timeline.what: Take out the jamón and chorizo.
Toast the bread; grate the tomato.
Build the board and the small dishes.
Make the first pan con tomate together.

faq.q: What goes on a Spanish tapas board?
faq.a: Aged Manchego, a second Spanish cheese like Mahón or Idiazabal, jamón serrano, dry chorizo, membrillo, Marcona almonds, Spanish olives, piquillo peppers and bread for pan con tomate.

faq.q: How do you make pan con tomate?
faq.a: Toast or grill slices of bread, rub them with a cut garlic clove, then rub a halved ripe tomato over the top. Finish with olive oil and salt.
Fino sherry, which is dry and nutty, or a Rioja Crianza.
